review_rationale: Inspected all terms of the graded-map criterion and the M/JM coefficient module, quotient ring R/J, polynomial variables, and J-adic associated graded pieces. Unlike M-regularity, quasi-regularity is defined here by a graded isomorphism and is not silently identified with an M-regular sequence.
